title: This Hand Kills You - Post Apocalyptic CCG
author: xThankYouFishx
selftext:
**Hey everyone!**

This is the first game I have gotten to this stage with in a few years and am a solo dev using AI assistants, just getting back in the coding game. "This Hand Kills You" has been in development internally and on paper for a couple years but finally started production in Late Feb.   
  
**All art is AI generated and I used GIMP for editing mostly, code is done by myself and AI as a team using GPT and later Bezi Integration.**

* A turn-based zombie survival card game with roguelite runs and persistent progression between them
* Build and upgrade your card collection across runs, with rarity and level scaling that actually matters
* Node-based maps mix enemy encounters and buildings, so every run plays out differently
* Mid-fight decisions keep combat tense: push through with fatigue penalties, or cut and run
* Death means losing your loot, so every encounter has real stakes

I am officially dropping the closed Alpha testing phase later today for a few close to me to try.  
  
**I would like to know what you guys think from the screenshots and am happy to field questions!**

**Little side note: The City Art is placeholder and was legacy so I kept it in because it was the first piece of art I generated and kept. Just a fun fact lol.**
